fields.description: Only for a base whose tax has a Kennzahl of its own, such as Kennzahl 46 with 47: the tax is derived from the balance at this rate. Empty or 0: no rate.
fields.label: Tax Rate (%)

fields.description: Reports the balance once more in an informational Kennzahl, such as Kennzahl 50 for bad debts.
fields.label: Additional Kennzahl

fields.description: For the annual return: the Feldkennung of the line the balance goes into, such as E3003405 for Kz 178 in line 25. Empty: the default of the role of the account, or the default line of its Kennzahl.
fields.label: Annual Return Field

fields.description: For lines 46, 52 and 54 of the annual return: the paragraph of the exempt sales, „Umsätze nach § … UStG“, such as 4 Nummer 14.
fields.label: Paragraph of the Exemption
